releaseNotes:
✨ What's new in v2.5:
• 📶 Critical Offline WebView Launch Fix: Integrated a native connection checker and dynamic cache fallback (LOAD_CACHE_ELSE_NETWORK) so the app loads seamlessly and completely offline without ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED errors!
• 🚀 Remote Engine Shell Upgrade: Fully redirects deep links and back actions to the live remote site origin.
